decisions.reason: As the flagship turnaround management product with a dedicated web page since launch, its high sunk costs and public commitment make withdrawal highly unlikely under escalation of commitment.
The firm has increased its visible commitment by giving the module its own page in 2024, and the sunk investment justifies persistence despite any disappointing results.

Although billing software is less central to the announced apron digitalization, the firm has invested and publicly committed to it, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it while attributing slow uptake to temporary market conditions.

The monitoring software ties closely to the firm's electrical equipment expertise and has gained a dedicated web page, so prior investments and public commitment make dropping it unlikely in the near term.
